description: List and track faxes on ICTFax, and send faxes when writes are enabled, over ICTCore REST.
name: io.github.ictinnovations/ictfax-mcp

environmentVariables.description: ICTCore REST base URL of your ICTFax server, normally ending in /api, e.g. https://your-ictfax/api.
environmentVariables.name: ICTFAX_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: API account email (ICTCore logs in by email).
environmentVariables.name: ICTFAX_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Account id to send faxes from. Defaults to 1.
environmentVariables.name: ICTFAX_ACCOUNT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks uploading documents and sending faxes, which dials a real number and can cost money. When false those tools are not registered at all. Leave off unless you mean it.
environmentVariables.name: ICTFAX_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: Per request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.
environmentVariables.name: ICTFAX_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Only for a self-signed test server.
environmentVariables.name: ICTFAX_TLS_INSECURE
